content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue, so retro authorization, records submission, peer-to-peer, and necessity appeal do not properly address it. No supported coding correction or modifier is identified, and resubmitting as-is risks an improper duplicate; patient billing is also inappropriate for a contractual bundling denial. A specialist must review the related paid service and payer bundling edits before choosing a correction or appeal path."}
